summary: End-to-end verification of NullCash swap pipeline. Backend 105/105 pytest green (98 prior + 7 new in tests/test_iter16_swap_full.py covering chains, tokens, near/tokens, Private-route full flow {quote -> order -> status}, Privacy-swap near full flow {near/quote -> near/orders -> near/orders/{id}}, disallowed-path 403, bogus-order 4xx). Frontend verified on https://offer-latest-dark.preview.emergentagent.com/app: Landing CTAs 'Swap without a wallet' and 'Launch app' both route to /app#private-route. Private route card renders dk-swap-card with testids dk-pick-source (preselected SOL/Solana), dk-pick-destination, dk-amount, dk-dest, dk-out, 3x dk-route-* rows, dk-refresh, dk-submit, dk-seg-private/dk-seg-privacy/dk-seg-track. Token picker (dk-pick-destination -> dk-token-modal with dk-token-search + chain tabs) returns 100+ matches for 'USDC', clicking Ethereum-Mainnet row sets receive; entering amount=5 produces quote 'out=0.21294399 ETH' (SOL->ETH@Arbitrum selected) and 3 ranked routes with 'Route 1 BEST'. Destination validation works: bad address shows 'Invalid Arbitrum address' with disabled dk-submit; valid 0x... address flips CTA to 'Review swap' (enabled). Submit triggers upstream order creation; sometimes the DarkSwap edge presents a Cloudflare 'Quick security check' overlay (#cb-verify) requiring a user tap — this is upstream bot-check behavior, the client already has retry/challenge handling and the equivalent order succeeds via API every time (verified in pytest). Track flow: #track with bogus id -> dk-track-error 'Couldn't find that order. Enter a valid order receipt ID.' (red). With live-created order id jF6wShsc9aLrPzKxGXXeiY -> dk-track-status shows 'WAITING FOR DEPOSIT', deposit address '4X3NRQUouP5...', 5 SOL -> 0.21259252 ETH, 5-step progress (Awaiting deposit/Confirming/Exchanging/Sending/Completed). Privacy swap tab (dk-seg-privacy / #privacy-swap) exposes extra dk-refund field; refund+dest validations function. Mobile 400x800: dk-swap-card width 372px (card inside 400 viewport), scrollWidth=clientWidth=400 (no horizontal overflow), 5 nc-dock-* tiles (Wallet/Hide/Pay/Swap/Menu). Upstream Swap tab routes to #private-route; Bridge tab renders 'Exit privately to any chain' wallet-gated card. Zero non-image console errors on any swap page.

integration_issues.issue: Upstream (DarkSwap/HoudiniSwap) intermittently returns Cloudflare bot-mitigation challenge. The client renders '#cb-verify' Quick security check with Verify button (expected per dk-swap.js submit() challenge-retry branch). Not a bug but worth noting that automated/UI tests cannot complete submit without user interaction when challenge fires. API-level POST /api/ds/orders succeeds 100% of the time in pytest.

design_issues.screen: Private route + Privacy swap token picker
issues: ~21 token-logo requests return 404 from /api/bifrost/v1/indexer/v1/logo/<mint> and /api/bifrost/v1/_img?k=... — the cards fall back to a text/color avatar so it is cosmetic, but console shows the 404 flood on every token-list render. Consider caching a 1x1 transparent PNG for unknown logos or suppressing the fetch when the upstream URL is empty.

action_items: Optional: silence or cache missing token-logo 404s from /api/bifrost/v1/indexer/v1/logo/* and /api/bifrost/v1/_img (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: dk-swap.js is 1510 lines (same as prior iteration finding) — Private + Privacy + Track + Chain + Nav + Intro all share one file. Consider modularizing for maintainability.

data-testid naming between the request spec and the actual code differs: review request references dk-pick-from/dk-pick-to but code uses dk-pick-source/dk-pick-destination; request references dk-seg-privacy (exists) and implies dk-seg-private-route but code uses dk-seg-private. Not a bug, document in agent context.

The upstream NEAR 1-Click router rejects well-known burn addresses (e.g. 0x...dEaD) with 'No Privacy swap route is available'. Backend passes the upstream error through unchanged with HTTP 400 — correct. If the UI ever auto-populates a demo/burn address for testing, Privacy swap will fail silently with 'No quote · adjust and retry'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids present and interactive; submit success is pending user tap when Cloudflare challenge appears, which is upstream behavior and already handled by client retry path)

rca of the issue: No functional issue found. Submit button occasionally triggers an upstream Cloudflare challenge (#cb-verify) — this is expected and already handled by dk-swap.js submit() with a 2.5s automatic retry (lines ~395-397). API-level order creation is 100% reliable (verified by pytest in both Private route and Privacy swap flows).
